about: Owner #122, #133, #134 (docs/design/future-lessons.md §6, §7): the generic mechanics, the foundation's verbs. A challenge is played only when a child can do it without reading (PlayReadless: its type's mechanic is kept, its things are pictures, numbers or short names spoken when touched, and its question is short enough to be said). Written choices and true-or-false claims are never dressed as games (shelved): those stay in the School as they are, counted as its reading debt. `say`: the words on the screen while the challenge is spoken (at most 7, rule 0). A unit is P0 until a signature game listed under signature replaces it (P1: one deep game at a time, future-lessons.md §4).

mechanics.name: Make it
mechanics.hook: The machine needs a number. Can you make it?
mechanics.does: make the number with blocks, coins, fraction bars, jumps, cups or weights

mechanics.name: Sort it
mechanics.hook: The sorting machine is stuck. Sort the things into the bins!
mechanics.does: put each thing into its bin, then run the machine

mechanics.name: Order it
mechanics.hook: The bridge is missing its planks. Lay them in order!
mechanics.does: lay the planks in order so the buddy can walk across

mechanics.name: Connect it
mechanics.hook: The lamps are dark. Connect each pair to light them!
mechanics.does: run a wire from each post to its partner, then switch on

mechanics.name: Fix it
mechanics.hook: The picture has lost its labels. Put them back!
mechanics.does: put each label on its pin, then start the machine

mechanics.name: Build it
mechanics.hook: Build it with blocks on the board!

mechanics.name: Code it
mechanics.hook: The robot needs a program to reach the flag!
mechanics.does: lay command cards and run the robot

mechanics.name: Beat it
mechanics.hook: The drums are quiet. Play the rhythm back!
mechanics.does: set each drum to a clap or a rest and play it

mechanics.name: Mix it
mechanics.hook: The painter needs a colour. Mix it in the bowl!
mechanics.does: add drops of paint to the bowl

mechanics.name: Find it
mechanics.hook: Something is hidden on the map. Find the spot!
mechanics.does: dig at a point on the map

mechanics.name: Choose by doing
mechanics.why: a written multiple-choice question in costume: the child still reads the question and its options, and a guess wins a third of the time (future-lessons.md §2: the mute and cheat tests)
mechanics.hook: A buddy needs your help. Bring the right thing!
mechanics.does: give the right thing to the buddy, or take the right path

mechanics.name: Test it
mechanics.why: a written claim to read, and a coin toss wins half the time (future-lessons.md §2: the mute and cheat tests)
mechanics.hook: Is it true? Test it at the gate!
mechanics.does: open the TRUE gate or the FALSE gate
